meta.title: Who lends to Guatemala's agri-SMEs? What the public record shows

csaf_figure.source_label: CSAF Open Data Portal — Data Table

meta.method: Public web search of CSAF members' and affiliates' own publications (annual and quarterly reports, partner pages, impact reports), CSAF's State of the Sector 2025 report, and third-party sources. No non-public data used.

A.label: Recent named lending
A.description: Lender or CSAF names the business as a borrower in a 2024–2025 publication.

B.label: Relationship confirmed, recent loan not shown
B.description: Lender publicly lists the business as a borrower or partner, but no public source shows a 2025 disbursement.

C.label: Older evidence
C.description: Most recent public evidence of lending predates 2024.

L.label: Lender only — no named borrower
L.description: Lender publicly lists Guatemala as a country of operation, but no Guatemalan borrower could be identified.

relationships.business: FECCEG (Federación Comercializadora de Café Especial de Guatemala)
relationships.note: Root Capital lending client since 2020; the loan that took Root Capital past $2 billion in cumulative lending was made to FECCEG.

relationships.note: SIDI partner page lists SIDI loan financing. Start date and loan status not shown.
Root Capital's first-ever client (1999). November 2024 story describes the ongoing relationship; no 2025 loan disclosed.
One of Oikocredit's oldest partners, financed since 1990. 2021 article reports a repaid export pre-financing loan and a new loan.
Exports fair trade and organic coffee from seven smallholder associations (3,800+ members). Oikocredit partner since 2016; partner data last synced May 2024.
relationships.source_label: Oikocredit partner page — Dinámica International Crops

relationships.note: Working capital to buy fresh vegetables from smallholders. Oikocredit partner since 2010; partner data last synced January 2025.

relationships.business: Manos Campesinas (Asociación Civil de Pequeños Productores de Café)
relationships.note: Borrower of Global Partnerships Impact-First Development Fund as of March 31, 2023, under its Smallholder Farmer Market Access initiative.
Fairtrade Access Fund lists Guatemala among its Latin America investment countries. No Guatemalan borrower named publicly.
Guatemala appears in Alterfin's Latin America country list in a fair trade pre-finance guide (older source). No Guatemalan borrower named publicly.
relationships.source_label: Plate-Forme pour le Commerce Équitable — Prefinancing guide

not_found.note: Searched with no Guatemala lending found: Shared Interest (its 2025 Central America producer committee covered Costa Rica, Honduras, Mexico and Nicaragua), Triodos Investment Management, responsAbility, Rabo Rural Fund, MCE Social Capital, NESsT.
